subject: Weekly tactical huddle: wins, at-risk items, and QBR prep (week of 2028-07-10)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 07:15:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly tactical huddle: wins, at-risk items, and QBR prep (week of 2028-07-10)

Team —

Quick readout for this week. TL;DR: momentum on Redwood Optimize pilots, one customer escalation brewing (Acme Health), and two asks for leadership ahead of the QBR pack.

Wins
- Redwood Optimize pilot with Outsight Partners moved to stage 2: initial latency reductions of ~18% in production simulation. (See attached QBR_scorecard_v2.xlsx, tab: Outsight)
- Dedicated capacity rollout for EU tenant A finished don't-run migration without incidents; on-call logs show no segfaults in the 72h window.

Risks / At-risk items
- Acme Health (related_account): they reported prompt hallucinations impacting a clinical triage flow. CS raised a severity-2. Need rapid root-cause and a mitigation plan for the QBR. Attachment: customer_impact_case.pdf (summary & customer messages)
- Ops: a small drift in tokenization config was discovered in canary; we produced ops_breach_log_excerpt.txt in case audit team asks during QBR.

Asks (action items for leadership distro)
1) Laura — can you confirm we have executive presence for the Acme Health QBR (they requested VP-level attendance)? If yes, will you join the call 7/19?
2) Jonas — prioritize a short RCA (one-pager) on the prompt hallucination vector and a proposed fallback; need draft by EOD Friday.
3) Markus + Soojin — review the QBR_scorecard_v2.xlsx and flag any metrics you want elevated to the pack by Friday morning (I marked recommended KPIs in orange).

Meeting cadence: I plan a 20-minute prep huddle on 7/18 (30m if more stakeholders join). Please reply inline with status.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Ops & Strategy | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: QBR_scorecard_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), customer_impact_case.pdf (summary), ops_breach_log_excerpt.txt (log excerpt)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly tactical huddle: wins, at-risk items, and QBR prep (week of 2028-07-10)

Hannah — thanks for the concise note. I can cover VP presence for Acme on 7/19 but need the one-pager RCA by EOD Friday to prep talking points.

Two quick asks back:
- Can someone highlight whether the hallucination spikes correspond to a model change or a prompt template drift? If it's model-related we may need to pull a short-term fallback model during the call.
- Please add any customer-facing remediation steps to the customer_impact_case.pdf so I can reference them.

I'll block 7/19 on my calendar tentatively.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly tactical huddle: wins, at-risk items, and QBR prep (week of 2028-07-10)

Laura / Hannah — working on the RCA brief now. Early signal: the hallucination cluster aligns with a prompt prefix revision we rolled two days before the customer report. My plan:

- Investigate tokenization and recent prompt-template commits (in progress)
- Run two A/B sims: current prompt vs. previous stable prompt to reproduce
- If reproduces, push a short-term fallback to the stable prompt + enable stricter system instructions for Acme's clinical flow

I attached a trimmed scorecard with the latency/KPI highlights and a scratch sheet with the A/B plan (QBR_scorecard_v2.xlsx - "A/B plan" tab). Expect the one-pager by Friday 17:00 PT.

On the VP presence: Laura, noted and thank you. I'll make sure the RCA includes the change window and the candidate mitigation so your talking points are crisp.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Platform Reliability | Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah. I've scanned the scorecard and flagged two items in the xlsx:
- Elevate "customer impact severity hours" (sheet: KPIs) — this should be on slide 2 of the QBR.
- Add a short note on "fallback model cost delta" so finance can see P&L impact if we flip to the safer variant during the call.

Hannah / Laura — thanks for the heads up and for moving quickly. A couple of clarifying items from our side before the QBR: 

- The hallucinations mostly appear when the triage flow receives patient notes that include shorthand (abbrev + emojis). Can your team reproduce with messy inputs?
- We're amenable to a temporary conservative model if it reduces false positives, but need an estimate of change window and any expected latency increase.

We'll plan to have our clinical SME on the 7/19 call. If helpful, I can share a redacted sample of problematic input before Friday.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Engineering Manager, Integrations | Acme Health
